title: Yellow orb tags along with Atlas launch
summary: Richard Barth tells of Yellow orb tags along with Atlas launch, about around May 1964 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Second stage took off. This or uh yellow orb came over and tracked the missile.

plain: Richard Barth, who says he worked as a guard at a nuclear missile base, describes on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels watching a launch of an Atlas rocket around May 1964 at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. He says that after the second stage fired, a yellow orb came over and followed the missile. If true, it would mean something was watching and keeping pace with American missile tests.
